part2.q: Where is the nearest bank?
part2.stem: Where is the nearest bank?
part2.explanation: Where(어디) 질문에는 장소로 답해요. Where 의문문에 Yes/No로 답할 수 없어요.

part2.q: When does the meeting start?
part2.stem: When does the meeting start?
part2.explanation: When(언제) 질문이라 시간으로 답해요. 장소 답(A)은 Where 질문용이에요.

part2.q: Who is in charge of the project?
part2.stem: Who is in charge of the project?
part2.explanation: Who(누구) 질문이라 사람으로 답해요. charge가 반복된 B는 뜻이 다른 함정이에요.

part2.q: Did you send the package?
part2.stem: Did you send the package?
part2.explanation: Did you ~? 질문에 Yes와 시점으로 답했어요. post office는 package에서 연상되는 함정이에요.

part2.q: How do you get to work?
part2.stem: How do you get to work?
part2.explanation: How(어떻게) 질문에 교통수단으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Would you like coffee or tea?
part2.stem: Would you like coffee or tea?
part2.explanation: A or B 선택 의문문에는 둘 중 하나를 골라 답해요. Yes/No는 어색해요.

part2.q: What time does the store close?
part2.stem: What time does the store close?
part2.explanation: What time(몇 시) 질문이라 시간으로 답해요. close(가까운)와 clothes(옷) 소리 함정이 있어요.

part2.q: Could you help me with this box?
part2.stem: Could you help me with this box?
choices: Sure, where should I put it?
part2.explanation: 부탁(Could you ~?)에는 수락이나 거절로 답해요. 수락하며 되묻는 A가 자연스러워요.
part2.qko: 이 상자 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?

part2.q: Why was the flight delayed?
part2.stem: Why was the flight delayed?
part2.explanation: Why(왜) 질문에 이유(Because of)로 답했어요. gate·window seat은 flight에서 연상되는 함정이에요.

part2.q: I can't find my keys.
part2.stem: I can't find my keys.
part2.explanation: 평서문에는 상황에 맞는 반응(되묻기, 제안)으로 답해요.

part2.q: Where should I leave these documents?
part2.stem: Where should I leave these documents?
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 장소(On my desk)로 답했어요. leave가 '떠나다'로 쓰인 C는 같은 단어 함정이에요.

part2.q: Haven't you finished the report yet?
part2.stem: Haven't you finished the report yet?
choices: I'll be done in an hour.
He reported it to the police.
part2.explanation: 부정 의문문은 긍정 의문문처럼 생각해요(보고서 끝냈어요?). '한 시간이면 끝나요'로 아직 안 끝났다는 걸 돌려 답했어요. report가 다른 뜻으로 반복된 B·C는 함정이에요.

part2.q: Who's going to lead the training session?
part2.stem: Who's going to lead the training session?
part2.explanation: Who 질문에 사람(새 컨설턴트)으로 답했어요. training과 train은 소리 함정이에요.

part2.q: Why don't we take a break?
part2.stem: Why don't we take a break?
part2.explanation: Why don't we ~?는 이유를 묻는 게 아니라 제안이에요. 동의하는 A가 정답이에요.

part2.q: When will the new printer arrive?
part2.stem: When will the new printer arrive?
choices: It should be here by Friday.
part2.explanation: When 질문에 시점(by Friday)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Should we meet in the morning or the afternoon?
part2.stem: Should we meet in the morning or the afternoon?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 '아무 때나 괜찮다(Either)'로 답하는 것도 정답 패턴이에요.

part2.q: How many people signed up for the workshop?
part2.stem: How many people signed up for the workshop?
part2.explanation: How many(몇 명) 질문에 수(About thirty)로 답했어요.

part2.q: The parking lot is closed today, isn't it?
part2.stem: The parking lot is closed today, isn't it?
part2.explanation: 부가 의문문(isn't it?)은 사실 확인이에요. Yes와 이유로 답했어요. lot(주차장)과 a lot of는 소리 함정이에요.

part2.q: Which supplier offers the lowest price?
part2.stem: Which supplier offers the lowest price?
choices: I'll check the quotes and let you know.
part2.explanation: '확인해 보고 알려 줄게요'는 Part 2 최빈출 간접 응답이에요. 모를 때도 정답이 될 수 있어요.
part2.qko: 어느 공급업체가 가장 싼 가격을 제시해요?

part2.q: The copier on the third floor is out of order again.
part2.stem: The copier on the third floor is out of order again.
part2.explanation: 고장 소식에 '수리 업체에 연락할게요'로 반응했어요. order가 '순서'로 쓰인 C는 함정이에요.

part2.q: When is the budget proposal due?
part2.stem: When is the budget proposal due?
choices: Didn't Mr. Kang send an e-mail about that?
part2.explanation: 되묻기로 답하는 간접 응답이에요. '강 씨가 이메일 보내지 않았어요?' = 거기에 마감일이 있다는 뜻이에요. due to(~때문에)는 같은 단어 함정이에요.
part2.ako: 강 씨가 그거 관련해서 이메일 보내지 않았어요?

part2.q: Who's going to replace Ms. Ortiz while she's on leave?
part2.stem: Who's going to replace Ms. Ortiz while she's on leave?
part2.explanation: '아직 결정되지 않았다'는 Who/When 질문에 자주 나오는 간접 응답이에요. replace와 place는 소리 함정이에요.
part2.qko: 오티즈 씨 휴가 동안 누가 대신해요?

part2.q: Isn't the conference being held in Busan this year?
part2.stem: Isn't the conference being held in Busan this year?
part2.explanation: 부정 의문문은 긍정으로 바꿔 생각해요(부산에서 열려요?). 아니라고 하고 대구로 옮겼다고 답했어요.

part2.q: Would you mind reviewing my presentation slides?
part2.stem: Would you mind reviewing my presentation slides?
choices: Not at all, send them over.
part2.explanation: Would you mind ~?에는 Not at all(전혀요=해 줄게요)이 수락이에요. Yes는 '싫다'는 뜻이 돼요.
part2.qko: 제 발표 자료 좀 검토해 줄래요?

part2.q: Why hasn't the shipment been sent out yet?
part2.stem: Why hasn't the shipment been sent out yet?
choices: We're still waiting for the labels.
part2.explanation: Why 질문에 Because 없이 이유를 말하는 답이에요. 라벨을 기다리는 중이라 못 보냈다는 뜻이에요.

part2.q: Do you want the report printed or sent electronically?
part2.stem: Do you want the report printed or sent electronically?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 '이메일이면 돼요'로 둘 중 하나(전자 파일)를 다른 말로 골랐어요. 바꿔 말하기 정답이에요.
part2.qko: 보고서 출력해 드릴까요, 파일로 보내 드릴까요?

part2.q: We've received more applications than we expected.
part2.stem: We've received more applications than we expected.
part2.explanation: 평서문에 대한 자연스러운 결과 반응이에요. 지원자가 많으면 면접관이 더 필요하다는 흐름이에요.

part2.q: How did the client react to our offer?
part2.stem: How did the client react to our offer?
choices: She wants a few days to think it over.
part2.explanation: How 질문에 반응(며칠 생각해 보겠다)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Where can I find the updated employee handbook?
part2.stem: Where can I find the updated employee handbook?
choices: It's been posted on the intranet.
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 '인트라넷에 올라왔다'로 장소를 답했어요. handbook과 hand는 소리 함정이에요.
part2.qko: 새 직원 안내서는 어디서 볼 수 있어요?

part2.q: Can you cover my shift on Saturday?
part2.stem: Can you cover my shift on Saturday?
choices: Sorry, I have plans that day.
part2.explanation: 부탁에 거절(Sorry, 선약이 있어요)도 정답이 될 수 있어요. cover와 shift가 다른 뜻으로 반복된 함정이에요.
part2.qko: 토요일 제 근무 좀 대신해 줄 수 있어요?

part2.q: Where can I buy a train ticket?
part2.stem: Where can I buy a train ticket?
choices: At the machine by the entrance.
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 장소(입구 옆 기계)로 답했어요.

part2.q: When did you start working here?
part2.stem: When did you start working here?
part2.explanation: When 질문에 과거 시점(2년 전쯤)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Who left this umbrella here?
part2.stem: Who left this umbrella here?
part2.explanation: Who 질문에 사람(박 씨 것 같다)으로 답했어요. left가 '왼쪽'으로 쓰인 C는 함정이에요.

part2.q: What's the weather like today?
part2.stem: What's the weather like today?
part2.explanation: 날씨를 묻는 질문에 날씨로 답했어요. weather와 whether는 소리가 같아요.

part2.q: Is this seat taken?
part2.stem: Is this seat taken?
choices: I'll take it to the office.
part2.explanation: Is this seat taken?(자리 있어요?)에 '아니요, 앉으세요'가 자연스러워요.

part2.q: How long is the movie?
part2.stem: How long is the movie?
part2.explanation: How long(얼마나 오래) 질문에 시간 길이로 답했어요.

part2.q: Why are you leaving early today?
part2.stem: Why are you leaving early today?
part2.explanation: Why 질문에 이유(치과 예약)로 답했어요.

part2.q: Can you turn on the lights?
part2.stem: Can you turn on the lights?
part2.explanation: 부탁에 수락(물론이죠)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Is the meeting today or tomorrow?
part2.stem: Is the meeting today or tomorrow?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 둘 중 하나(내일)를 골랐어요.

part2.q: It's really cold in this room.
part2.stem: It's really cold in this room.
part2.explanation: 춥다는 말에 '난방을 올릴게요'로 반응했어요.

part2.q: Where did you put the stapler?
part2.stem: Where did you put the stapler?
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 장소(맨 위 서랍)로 답했어요.

part2.q: When is your flight?
part2.stem: When is your flight?
part2.explanation: When 질문에 시간(정오)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Who's your new manager?
part2.stem: Who's your new manager?
choices: Ms. Kim from the Seoul office.
part2.explanation: Who 질문에 사람(서울 사무소 김 씨)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Do you have a pen I could use?
part2.stem: Do you have a pen I could use?
part2.explanation: 빌려 달라는 말에 펜을 건네며 답했어요.

part2.q: How was your vacation?
part2.stem: How was your vacation?
part2.explanation: How was ~?(어땠어요)에 소감으로 답했어요. 기간·교통수단은 다른 질문의 답이에요.

part2.q: What's your phone number?
part2.stem: What's your phone number?
part2.explanation: 전화번호를 묻는 질문에 번호로 답했어요.

part2.q: Let's have lunch together.
part2.stem: Let's have lunch together.
choices: I had a big breakfast yesterday.
part2.explanation: 제안(Let's ~)에 동의(좋아요)로 답했어요.

part2.q: Why is the store closed?
part2.stem: Why is the store closed?
part2.explanation: Why 질문에 이유(공휴일)로 답했어요.

part2.q: Do you want to walk or take a taxi?
part2.stem: Do you want to walk or take a taxi?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 걷자고 고르고 이유를 덧붙였어요.

part2.q: The printer is out of paper.
part2.stem: The printer is out of paper.
part2.explanation: 용지가 떨어졌다는 말에 '캐비닛에 더 있어요'로 반응했어요.

part2.q: Where will the awards ceremony be held?
part2.stem: Where will the awards ceremony be held?
choices: In the ballroom of the Grand Hotel.
She won the award last year.
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 장소(그랜드 호텔 연회장)로 답했어요.

part2.q: When are you going to submit the budget?
part2.stem: When are you going to submit the budget?
choices: As soon as the director approves it.
part2.explanation: 구체적인 날짜 대신 '이사가 승인하는 대로'라는 조건으로 답하는 것도 When의 정답 패턴이에요.

part2.q: Who should I talk to about my paycheck?
part2.stem: Who should I talk to about my paycheck?
part2.explanation: Who 질문에 부서(급여 담당 부서 사람)로 답하는 것도 정답이에요.

part2.q: Didn't you order more envelopes?
part2.stem: Didn't you order more envelopes?
part2.explanation: 부정 의문문은 긍정처럼(주문했어요?) 생각해요. Yes + 도착 시점으로 답했어요.

part2.q: You've met our new intern, haven't you?
part2.stem: You've met our new intern, haven't you?
choices: Not yet, but I'd like to.
part2.explanation: 부가 의문문은 사실 확인이에요. '아직이요, 만나 보고 싶어요'로 답했어요.

part2.q: How much will the repairs cost?
part2.stem: How much will the repairs cost?
choices: We're still waiting for an estimate.
part2.explanation: 아직 모른다는 간접 응답(견적을 기다리는 중)이에요.

part2.q: How about moving the meeting to Thursday?
part2.stem: How about moving the meeting to Thursday?
part2.explanation: How about ~?는 제안이에요. 목요일이 모두에게 괜찮다고 동의했어요.

part2.q: Would you mind closing the window?
part2.stem: Would you mind closing the window?
part2.explanation: Would you mind ~?에 Not at all은 '해 줄게요'라는 수락이에요.

part2.q: Should I send the files by e-mail or bring them in person?
part2.stem: Should I send the files by e-mail or bring them in person?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 이메일을 고르고 이유를 붙였어요.

part2.q: Why did the sales team miss its target?
part2.stem: Why did the sales team miss its target?
choices: Two big clients canceled their orders.
part2.explanation: Why 질문에 Because 없이 이유(큰 고객 두 곳이 주문 취소)를 말했어요.
part2.ako: 큰 고객 두 곳이 주문을 취소했어요.

part2.q: How often do you check your e-mail?
part2.stem: How often do you check your e-mail?
part2.explanation: How often(얼마나 자주)에 빈도로 답했어요.

part2.q: What did you think of the new design?
part2.stem: What did you think of the new design?
choices: I liked the colors a lot.
part2.explanation: 의견을 묻는 질문에 소감(색이 좋았다)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: I can't log in to the system.
part2.stem: I can't log in to the system.
part2.explanation: 문제를 말하는 평서문에 해결책을 되물었어요.

part2.q: Where's the closest place to get coffee?
part2.stem: Where's the closest place to get coffee?
choices: There's a café on the first floor.
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 장소(1층 카페)로 답했어요. closest와 close는 소리 함정이에요.
part2.qko: 커피 살 만한 데가 어디가 제일 가까워요?

part2.q: When will the renovation be finished?
part2.stem: When will the renovation be finished?
choices: By the end of the month, hopefully.
part2.explanation: When 질문에 시점(이달 말)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Is the conference room available this afternoon?
part2.stem: Is the conference room available this afternoon?
choices: Let me check the booking system.
part2.explanation: Yes/No 질문에 '예약 시스템을 확인해 볼게요'라는 간접 응답이에요.

part2.q: Who's responsible for ordering office supplies?
part2.stem: Who's responsible for ordering office supplies?
part2.explanation: Who 질문에 사람(린다)으로 답했어요. That would be ~는 사람을 가리키는 자연스러운 표현이에요.

part2.q: Aren't you coming to the training session?
part2.stem: Aren't you coming to the training session?
choices: I have to meet a client at that time.
part2.explanation: 못 간다는 걸 이유로 돌려 답했어요.

part2.q: Which hotel are we staying at in Tokyo?
part2.stem: Which hotel are we staying at in Tokyo?
choices: The travel agent hasn't confirmed yet.
part2.explanation: 아직 확정되지 않았다는 간접 응답이에요.
part2.ako: 여행사에서 아직 확정 안 해 줬어요.

part2.q: The new software is really easy to use.
part2.stem: The new software is really easy to use.
part2.explanation: 칭찬에 '마음에 든다니 다행이네요'로 반응했어요.

part2.q: Has the contract been signed yet?
part2.stem: Has the contract been signed yet?
choices: The lawyers are reviewing it now.
part2.explanation: Yes/No 대신 진행 상황(변호사 검토 중 = 아직)으로 답했어요.

part2.q: Where should we hold the staff party this year?
part2.stem: Where should we hold the staff party this year?
choices: How about the place we used last year?
part2.explanation: 질문에 제안으로 되묻는 간접 응답이에요.

part2.q: Shouldn't we hire more staff for the holiday season?
part2.stem: Shouldn't we hire more staff for the holiday season?
part2.explanation: 부정 의문문 제안에 '예산이 안 된다'로 돌려 거절했어요.
part2.qko: 연휴 시즌에 직원을 더 뽑아야 하지 않을까요?

part2.q: The client wants the design changed again.
part2.stem: The client wants the design changed again.
choices: Did they say what they didn't like?
Change trains at the next stop.
part2.explanation: 상황에 대해 이유를 되묻는 반응이에요.

part2.q: Are you presenting the results, or is Ms. Lee?
part2.stem: Are you presenting the results, or is Ms. Lee?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 '둘 다(함께)'로 답하는 것도 정답 패턴이에요.
part2.qko: 결과는 당신이 발표해요, 이 씨가 해요?

part2.q: When does the new policy take effect?
part2.stem: When does the new policy take effect?
part2.explanation: 메모를 안 읽었냐고 되묻는 간접 응답(메모에 나와 있다)이에요. effect와 effective는 소리 함정이에요.

part2.q: Could you show the new hire around the office?
part2.stem: Could you show the new hire around the office?
choices: I'm afraid I'm tied up all morning.
part2.explanation: 부탁에 '오전 내내 바빠서 어렵다'는 완곡한 거절로 답했어요.
part2.qko: 신입 사원에게 사무실 좀 안내해 줄래요?

part2.q: Why don't you take tomorrow off?
part2.stem: Why don't you take tomorrow off?
choices: I have a deadline on Friday.
I took it off the shelf.
part2.explanation: Why don't you ~?는 제안이에요. 마감 때문에 어렵다고 돌려 답했어요.

part2.q: How did the product launch go?
part2.stem: How did the product launch go?
part2.explanation: How did ~ go?(어땠어요)에 결과로 답했어요. 다음 주 출시는 시제가 안 맞아요.

part2.q: The shipment should arrive by Friday, shouldn't it?
part2.stem: The shipment should arrive by Friday, shouldn't it?
choices: There's been a delay at customs.
part2.explanation: 부가 의문문에 '세관에서 지연됐다(=금요일엔 어렵다)'로 간접 답변했어요.

part2.q: Who approved this purchase order?
part2.stem: Who approved this purchase order?
choices: It must have been the department head.
part2.explanation: Who 질문에 추측(부서장이었을 거예요)으로 답했어요. approved와 prove는 소리 함정이에요.

part2.q: What's the best way to reach the convention center?
part2.stem: What's the best way to reach the convention center?
choices: The subway is quickest at this hour.
part2.explanation: 가는 방법을 묻는 질문에 교통수단으로 답했어요.
part2.qko: 컨벤션 센터까지 가장 좋은 방법이 뭐예요?

part2.q: I heard the cafeteria is closing for renovations.
part2.stem: I heard the cafeteria is closing for renovations.
choices: Only for two weeks, I think.
part2.explanation: 소식에 '2주만이래요'라고 정보를 더하는 반응이에요.

part2.q: Will Mr. Tanaka be joining us for dinner?
part2.stem: Will Mr. Tanaka be joining us for dinner?
part2.explanation: Yes/No 대신 '비행기가 지연됐다(=못 온다)'로 돌려 답했어요.

part2.q: How many copies of the report do you need?
part2.stem: How many copies of the report do you need?
part2.explanation: 숫자 대신 '이사 한 명당 한 부'로 답하는 바꿔 말하기 정답이에요.

part2.q: Wouldn't it be better to postpone the launch?
part2.stem: Wouldn't it be better to postpone the launch?
part2.explanation: 제안에 '이미 날짜를 발표했다'로 어렵다는 뜻을 전했어요.

part2.q: Where are the extra chairs for the seminar?
part2.stem: Where are the extra chairs for the seminar?
choices: Maintenance is bringing them up now.
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 '관리팀이 지금 가져오는 중'이라는 간접 응답이에요.

part2.q: When can you start on the new project?
part2.stem: When can you start on the new project?
choices: As soon as I wrap up this report.
part2.explanation: 구체적 시간 대신 조건(이 보고서를 마무리하는 대로)으로 답했어요.
part2.qko: 새 프로젝트는 언제 시작할 수 있어요?

part2.q: Would you prefer an aisle seat or a window seat?
part2.stem: Would you prefer an aisle seat or a window seat?
part2.explanation: 선택 의문문에 '아무거나 남은 걸로'로 답하는 것도 정답이에요.

part2.q: Haven't the brochures been printed yet?
part2.stem: Haven't the brochures been printed yet?
choices: The printer ran out of ink this morning.
part2.explanation: 아직이라는 걸 이유(잉크가 떨어짐)로 돌려 답했어요.
part2.qko: 안내 책자 아직 인쇄 안 됐어요?

part2.q: Where is the meeting room?
part2.stem: Where is the meeting room?
part2.explanation: Where 질문에 장소로 답했어요.

part2.q: Who will give the presentation tomorrow?
part2.stem: Who will give the presentation tomorrow?
part2.explanation: 아직 정해지지 않았다는 간접 응답이에요.

part2.q: Didn't you already submit the expense report?
part2.stem: Didn't you already submit the expense report?
choices: I'm still waiting for one receipt.
part2.explanation: 아직 안 냈다는 걸 이유(영수증 하나를 기다림)로 돌려 답했어요.

sets.title: Ordering supplies

lines.text: Hi, Tom. We're almost out of printer paper. Could you order some more today?
Sure. How many boxes do we need? Last time I ordered five.
Let's get ten this time. We have a big presentation next week, and we'll be printing a lot.
OK. I'll place the order this afternoon. It should arrive by Thursday.

sets.ko: 여: 톰, 프린터 용지가 거의 떨어졌어요. 오늘 좀 더 주문해 줄래요? / 남: 물론이죠. 몇 상자 필요해요? 지난번엔 다섯 상자 주문했어요. / 여: 이번엔 열 상자로 해요. 다음 주에 큰 발표가 있어서 많이 출력할 거예요. / 남: 알겠어요. 오늘 오후에 주문할게요. 목요일까지는 올 거예요.

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explanation: 여자가 첫 말에서 Could you order some more(용지를 더 주문해 줄래요)라고 했어요. printer paper를 '용지'로 바꿔 말한 B가 정답이에요.

questions.stem: How many boxes will the man order?
questions.explanation: Let's get ten this time. 다섯(five)은 지난번 주문 수라 함정이에요.

questions.stem: When will the order probably arrive?
questions.explanation: 마지막 말 It should arrive by Thursday. next week는 발표 시점이라 함정이에요.

sets.title: Restaurant reservation

lines.text: Good evening, Lucia's Restaurant. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to book a table for four people on Saturday at seven.
I'm sorry, we're fully booked at seven. Would eight o'clock work for you?
Yes, that's fine. And could we have a table by the window?
Of course. May I have your name, please?

sets.ko: 남: 안녕하세요, 루시아 레스토랑입니다. / 여: 토요일 7시에 네 명 예약하고 싶어요. / 남: 죄송하지만 7시는 예약이 다 찼어요. 8시는 괜찮으세요? / 여: 네, 좋아요. 창가 자리로 해 주실 수 있어요? / 남: 물론이죠. 성함이 어떻게 되세요?

questions.stem: Why is the woman calling?
questions.explanation: I'd like to book a table = 예약하고 싶다. book을 reservation으로 바꿔 말했어요.

questions.stem: What problem does the man mention?
choices: The restaurant is closed on Saturday.
A table is not available at seven.
questions.explanation: we're fully booked at seven = 7시는 자리가 없다.

questions.stem: What does the man ask for?
questions.explanation: 마지막 말 May I have your name? 인원(four)은 이미 말했어요.

sets.title: Changing a training date

lines.text: Rachel, I just got an e-mail from the IT department. The software training scheduled for Monday has been moved.
Really? To when? I've already told my whole team about Monday.
It's now on Wednesday morning because the trainer has a conflict. The room has changed, too. We'll be in Room 305 instead of the main hall.
OK. I'll send my team an update right away so nobody goes to the wrong place.

sets.ko: 남: 레이철, 방금 IT 부서에서 이메일이 왔는데 월요일 소프트웨어 교육이 옮겨졌대요. / 여: 정말요? 언제로요? 팀 전체에 월요일이라고 이미 말했는데요. / 남: 강사 일정이 겹쳐서 수요일 오전으로 바뀌었어요. 장소도 바뀌어서 대강당 대신 305호예요. / 여: 알겠어요. 아무도 엉뚱한 곳에 가지 않게 팀에 바로 알릴게요.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: 교육 일정이 월요일에서 수요일로 바뀐 이야기예요. has been moved = 일정 변경.

questions.stem: Why was the training moved?
questions.explanation: the trainer has a conflict(강사 일정이 겹친다) = 강사가 시간이 안 된다(unavailable). 바꿔 말하기예요.

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do next?
questions.explanation: I'll send my team an update = 팀원들에게 알리겠다.

sets.title: Office move (3 speakers)

lines.text: Kevin, Mark, thanks for meeting. As you know, our department is moving to the fifth floor next month.
Do we know the exact date yet? I need to plan around a client visit on the twelfth.
The move is set for the fifteenth, so your visit won't be affected.
What about our files? Will a moving company pack them for us?
Yes, but please label your boxes by the tenth so the movers know where everything goes.

sets.ko: 여: 케빈, 마크, 모여 줘서 고마워요. 알다시피 다음 달 우리 부서가 5층으로 이사해요. / 남1: 정확한 날짜 나왔어요? 12일에 고객 방문이 있어서요. / 여: 이사는 15일로 정해져서 방문에는 영향이 없어요. / 남2: 우리 서류는요? 이사 업체가 싸 주나요? / 여: 네, 하지만 업체가 위치를 알 수 있게 10일까지 상자에 이름표를 붙여 주세요.

questions.stem: What is the conversation mainly about?
questions.explanation: moving to the fifth floor = 사무실 이전(relocation).

questions.stem: When will the move take place?
choices: At the end of the month
questions.explanation: The move is set for the fifteenth. 10일은 이름표 마감, 12일은 고객 방문이라 함정이에요.

questions.stem: What are the men asked to do?
questions.explanation: please label your boxes by the tenth. 짐은 업체가 싸 준다고 했으니 A는 틀려요.

sets.title: Budget discussion

lines.text: Have you looked at the quote from the catering company for the anniversary event?
I have, and it's about twenty percent higher than what we budgeted. I'm not sure the finance team will approve it.
What if we reduced the number of hot dishes and added more salads? That usually brings the price down.
That could work. I'll ask them to send a revised quote, and then we can present both options to finance on Friday.

sets.ko: 남: 창립 기념 행사 출장 뷔페 업체 견적 봤어요? / 여: 봤는데 예산보다 20% 정도 높아요. 재무팀이 승인할지 모르겠어요. / 남: 따뜻한 요리를 줄이고 샐러드를 늘리면 어때요? 보통 그러면 가격이 내려가요. / 여: 그거 괜찮겠네요. 수정 견적을 보내 달라고 하고, 금요일에 재무팀에 두 안을 다 보여 줘요.

questions.stem: What problem does the woman mention?
choices: A price is higher than planned.
questions.explanation: twenty percent higher than what we budgeted = 계획(예산)보다 비싸다.

questions.stem: What does the man suggest?
questions.explanation: 요리를 줄이고 샐러드를 늘리자 = 메뉴를 바꾸자(changing the menu).

questions.stem: What will the speakers do on Friday?
choices: Show options to the finance team
questions.explanation: present both options to finance on Friday.

sets.title: Customer service call

lines.text: Thank you for calling Brightline Internet. This is Amy speaking.
Hi, my internet connection has been dropping every few hours since Tuesday. I work from home, so it's a real problem.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can see there was some maintenance in your area this week. Let me reset your connection from here. Could you restart your router in about two minutes?
Sure. And if that doesn't fix it?
Then I'll schedule a technician visit. There's no charge, since the problem is on our side.

sets.ko: 여: 브라이트라인 인터넷입니다. 에이미예요. / 남: 화요일부터 몇 시간마다 인터넷이 끊겨요. 재택근무라 정말 문제예요. / 여: 죄송합니다. 이번 주 고객님 지역에 점검이 있었네요. 여기서 연결을 재설정할게요. 2분쯤 뒤에 공유기를 다시 켜 주시겠어요? / 남: 네. 그래도 안 되면요? / 여: 그럼 기사 방문을 잡아 드릴게요. 저희 쪽 문제라 비용은 없어요.

questions.stem: Why is the man calling?
questions.explanation: 인터넷이 계속 끊긴다고 문제를 알리러 전화했어요.

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explanation: restart your router = 기기를 다시 켜라. router를 device로 바꿔 말했어요.

questions.stem: What does the woman say about the technician visit?
questions.explanation: There's no charge = 무료(free).

sets.title: Store announcement

lines.text: Attention, shoppers. Today only, all winter coats are fifty percent off on the second floor. In addition, customers who spend more than one hundred dollars will receive a free scarf. The store will close at nine tonight. Thank you for shopping at Parkview Department Store.

sets.ko: 쇼핑객 여러분, 오늘 하루만 2층 겨울 코트 전 품목 50% 할인합니다. 또한 100달러 넘게 구매하시면 목도리를 무료로 드립니다. 오늘 매장은 밤 9시에 문을 닫습니다. 파크뷰 백화점을 이용해 주셔서 감사합니다.

questions.stem: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.explanation: shoppers, Parkview Department Store로 장소를 알 수 있어요.

questions.stem: What is on sale?
questions.explanation: all winter coats are fifty percent off. 목도리는 사은품이라 함정이에요.

questions.stem: How can customers get a free gift?
choices: By spending over one hundred dollars
By signing up for a card
questions.explanation: customers who spend more than one hundred dollars will receive a free scarf.

sets.title: Voicemail message

lines.text: Hi, this is Daniel from Greenway Dental Clinic calling for Ms. Harper. I'm calling to remind you of your appointment tomorrow at three p.m. with Dr. Patel. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to fill out some forms, since this is your first visit. If you need to reschedule, call us at 555-0142 before noon today. Thank you.

sets.ko: 안녕하세요, 그린웨이 치과의 대니얼입니다. 하퍼 씨께 전화드렸어요. 내일 오후 3시 파텔 선생님 진료 예약을 알려 드리려고요. 첫 방문이시라 서류 작성을 위해 15분 일찍 와 주세요. 일정을 바꾸시려면 오늘 정오 전까지 555-0142로 전화 주세요. 감사합니다.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the call?
choices: To remind someone of an appointment
questions.explanation: I'm calling to remind you of your appointment.

questions.stem: Why should the listener arrive early?
questions.explanation: to fill out some forms = 서류 작성(complete paperwork). 바꿔 말하기예요.

questions.stem: What should the listener do to reschedule?
questions.explanation: call us ... before noon today.

sets.title: Tour guide

lines.text: Welcome to the Riverside History Museum. My name is Grace, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour will last about an hour and will cover three galleries. Please note that photography is allowed, but flash is not, as it can damage the older paintings. At the end of the tour, you're welcome to visit our gift shop, where museum members get a ten percent discount.

sets.ko: 리버사이드 역사박물관에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 오늘 가이드를 맡은 그레이스입니다. 투어는 약 한 시간 동안 세 개 전시관을 돌아봅니다. 사진 촬영은 되지만 플래시는 오래된 그림을 손상시킬 수 있어 안 됩니다. 투어가 끝나면 기념품점에 들르셔도 좋고, 박물관 회원은 10% 할인을 받습니다.

questions.stem: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.explanation: I'll be your guide today.

questions.stem: What are listeners asked not to do?
questions.explanation: photography is allowed, but flash is not.

questions.stem: What is mentioned about the gift shop?
choices: It is on the third floor.
questions.explanation: museum members get a ten percent discount.

sets.title: Business news

lines.text: In business news, local electronics maker Novatek announced today that it will open a new factory in Ulsan next spring. The company says the facility will create around three hundred jobs and allow it to double its production of batteries. Novatek's CEO noted that strong demand from overseas customers was the main reason for the expansion. Construction is expected to begin in March, pending final approval from city officials.

sets.ko: 경제 소식입니다. 지역 전자 업체 노바텍이 내년 봄 울산에 새 공장을 연다고 오늘 발표했습니다. 회사는 이 시설로 약 300개의 일자리가 생기고 배터리 생산량을 두 배로 늘릴 수 있다고 밝혔습니다. 노바텍 CEO는 해외 고객의 높은 수요가 확장의 주된 이유라고 말했습니다. 시 당국의 최종 승인을 거쳐 3월에 공사가 시작될 예정입니다.

questions.stem: What is the news report mainly about?
questions.explanation: will open a new factory = 공장 개설.

questions.stem: According to the speaker, why is the company expanding?
choices: Because of high demand from abroad
questions.explanation: strong demand from overseas customers = 해외(abroad) 수요. 바꿔 말하기예요.

questions.stem: What is needed before construction can begin?
questions.explanation: pending final approval from city officials = 시 당국 승인이 있어야 한다.

sets.title: Lost card

lines.text: Excuse me, I think I left my company ID card here at the front desk this morning.
Let me check. What's your name?
It's David Choi. I work in the accounting department on the fourth floor.
Yes, here it is. Someone found it near the elevator and brought it down an hour ago.
Great, thank you. I couldn't get into my office without it.

sets.ko: 남: 실례지만 오늘 아침 안내 데스크에 사원증을 두고 간 것 같아요. / 여: 확인해 볼게요. 성함이 어떻게 되세요? / 남: 데이비드 최예요. 4층 회계부에서 일해요. / 여: 네, 여기 있어요. 누가 엘리베이터 근처에서 주워서 한 시간 전에 가져왔어요. / 남: 다행이네요, 고마워요. 그게 없어서 사무실에 못 들어갔어요.

questions.stem: What is the man looking for?
questions.explanation: company ID card = 사원증.

questions.stem: Where does the man work?
questions.explanation: I work in the accounting department on the fourth floor.

questions.stem: Where was the item found?
questions.explanation: Someone found it near the elevator. 안내 데스크는 지금 보관 중인 곳이라 함정이에요.

sets.title: Printer problem

lines.text: Hi, is this the IT help desk? The printer on the second floor isn't working.
What's happening when you try to print?
A red light is flashing, and nothing comes out.
That usually means there's a paper jam. I'll come up in ten minutes to take a look.
Thanks. In the meantime, I'll use the printer on the third floor.

sets.ko: 여: IT 지원팀이죠? 2층 프린터가 안 돼요. / 남: 인쇄하려고 하면 어떻게 돼요? / 여: 빨간 불이 깜빡이고 아무것도 안 나와요. / 남: 보통 종이가 걸렸다는 뜻이에요. 10분 뒤에 올라가서 볼게요. / 여: 고마워요. 그동안 3층 프린터를 쓸게요.

questions.stem: Why is the woman calling?
choices: To ask for a new computer
questions.explanation: The printer on the second floor isn't working.

questions.stem: What does the man think the problem is?
questions.explanation: there's a paper jam = 종이가 걸렸다(stuck).

questions.stem: What will the woman do in the meantime?
questions.explanation: I'll use the printer on the third floor = 다른 프린터를 쓴다.

sets.title: Conference registration

lines.text: Hi, I registered for the marketing conference next month, but I need to change my registration from three days to just one day.
No problem. Which day would you like to attend?
The second day, please. That's when the social media workshops are.
OK, I've updated it. Since the one-day pass is cheaper, we'll refund the difference to your credit card within five business days.
Perfect. Will I get a new confirmation e-mail?
Yes, it should arrive in a few minutes.

sets.ko: 남: 다음 달 마케팅 학회에 등록했는데 3일권을 1일권으로 바꾸고 싶어요. / 여: 네, 며칠째에 참석하시겠어요? / 남: 둘째 날이요. 소셜 미디어 워크숍이 있는 날이라서요. / 여: 변경했어요. 1일권이 더 싸니 차액은 영업일 5일 안에 신용카드로 환불됩니다. / 남: 좋네요. 새 확인 이메일이 오나요? / 여: 네, 몇 분 안에 갈 거예요.

questions.stem: What does the man want to do?
questions.explanation: change my registration from three days to just one day.

questions.stem: Why does the man choose the second day?
choices: Workshops he is interested in are held.
He is busy on the other days.
questions.explanation: That's when the social media workshops are = 관심 있는 워크숍이 있다.

questions.stem: What will the man receive?
choices: A refund and a new e-mail

sets.title: Delivery delay

lines.text: Hello, I'm calling about an order of office chairs that was supposed to arrive yesterday. It hasn't come yet.
I'm sorry about that. Could you give me your order number?
Thank you. It looks like the truck had mechanical problems. The chairs will be delivered tomorrow morning instead.
That's fine, but we have new employees starting tomorrow at nine. Can it come before then?
I'll ask the driver to make your office the first stop.

sets.ko: 여: 어제 오기로 한 사무용 의자 주문 건으로 전화했어요. 아직 안 왔어요. / 남: 죄송합니다. 주문 번호를 알려 주시겠어요? / 여: 45821이에요. / 남: 감사합니다. 트럭에 기계 문제가 있었네요. 대신 내일 아침에 배달됩니다. / 여: 괜찮은데, 내일 9시에 신입 직원들이 출근해요. 그 전에 올 수 있을까요? / 남: 기사에게 그쪽 사무실을 첫 번째로 들르라고 할게요.

questions.stem: What problem does the woman report?
questions.explanation: hasn't come yet = 아직 도착하지 않았다.

questions.stem: What caused the delay?
questions.explanation: the truck had mechanical problems.

questions.stem: What does the man promise to do?
questions.explanation: make your office the first stop = 첫 번째로 배달.

sets.title: Hiring decision (3 speakers)

lines.text: So, we've interviewed all five candidates for the designer position. What did you both think?
I was most impressed by Ms. Rivera. Her portfolio showed exactly the kind of work our clients want.
I agree her work is strong, but she's asking for a higher salary than we budgeted.
Hmm. Could we offer a smaller salary with a signing bonus instead? That would keep our monthly costs down.
That might work. I'll check with HR to see if a bonus is possible this quarter.
And I'll call Ms. Rivera tomorrow to ask whether she'd consider that.

sets.ko: 여: 디자이너 후보 다섯 명 면접을 다 봤어요. 두 분 생각은 어때요? / 남1: 리베라 씨가 가장 인상적이었어요. 포트폴리오가 고객들이 원하는 작업 그대로였어요. / 남2: 실력은 좋지만 예산보다 높은 연봉을 원해요. / 여: 음, 연봉은 조금 낮추고 입사 보너스를 주면 어때요? 월 비용을 줄일 수 있어요. / 남2: 그럴 수도 있겠네요. 이번 분기에 보너스가 가능한지 인사팀에 확인할게요. / 남1: 저는 내일 리베라 씨에게 전화해서 그 조건을 고려할지 물어볼게요.

questions.stem: What are the speakers discussing?
choices: Whom to hire for a position
questions.explanation: 디자이너 직책 후보를 고르는 이야기예요.

questions.stem: What concern is mentioned about Ms. Rivera?
questions.explanation: she's asking for a higher salary than we budgeted.

questions.stem: What will the man who praised Ms. Rivera do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: I'll call Ms. Rivera tomorrow. 인사팀 확인은 다른 남자(M2)가 해요.

sets.title: Store layout

lines.text: Have you seen the sales numbers since we moved the snack aisle to the front of the store?
Yes, snack sales are up almost thirty percent. But some customers have complained that it's now harder to find the dairy section.
That's a fair point. What if we put up larger signs above each aisle?
Good idea. I'll order the signs today. They should be ready by the weekend, so we can put them up before our busy Saturday morning.

sets.ko: 남: 과자 코너를 매장 앞쪽으로 옮긴 뒤 매출 봤어요? / 여: 네, 과자 매출이 거의 30% 올랐어요. 그런데 유제품 코너 찾기가 어려워졌다는 손님 불만이 있어요. / 남: 일리 있네요. 통로마다 위에 더 큰 표지판을 달면 어때요? / 여: 좋아요. 오늘 표지판을 주문할게요. 주말까지는 나올 테니 바쁜 토요일 오전 전에 달 수 있어요.

questions.stem: What change did the store make?
questions.explanation: moved the snack aisle to the front = 코너 위치를 옮겼다.

questions.stem: What problem does the woman mention?
choices: A section is hard to find.
questions.explanation: harder to find the dairy section.

questions.stem: What will the woman do today?
questions.explanation: I'll order the signs today. 다는 건 주말 뒤라 A는 함정이에요.

sets.title: Airport announcement

lines.text: Attention, passengers on Flight 208 to Singapore. The departure gate has changed from Gate 12 to Gate 25. Boarding will begin in twenty minutes. Passengers traveling with small children may board first. We apologize for any inconvenience.

sets.ko: 싱가포르행 208편 승객 여러분께 알려 드립니다. 탑승구가 12번에서 25번으로 바뀌었습니다. 탑승은 20분 뒤 시작됩니다. 어린 자녀를 동반한 승객은 먼저 탑승하실 수 있습니다. 불편을 드려 죄송합니다.

questions.stem: What is the announcement about?
questions.explanation: The departure gate has changed.

questions.stem: When will boarding begin?
questions.explanation: Boarding will begin in twenty minutes.

questions.stem: Who can board first?
questions.explanation: Passengers traveling with small children may board first.

sets.title: Office reminder

lines.text: Good morning, everyone. This is a reminder that the office will be closed on Monday for the national holiday. The cleaning staff will use the day to wax the floors, so please take any food out of the kitchen refrigerator by Friday afternoon. We'll be back to normal hours on Tuesday. Enjoy the long weekend.

sets.ko: 여러분 좋은 아침입니다. 월요일은 공휴일이라 사무실이 쉰다는 점 다시 알려 드립니다. 청소 직원들이 그날 바닥 왁스 작업을 하니 금요일 오후까지 탕비실 냉장고의 음식을 모두 빼 주세요. 화요일부터 정상 근무합니다. 긴 주말 즐겁게 보내세요.

questions.stem: Why will the office be closed on Monday?
questions.explanation: closed on Monday for the national holiday.

questions.stem: What are listeners asked to do?
questions.explanation: take any food out of the kitchen refrigerator.

questions.stem: When will normal hours resume?
questions.explanation: back to normal hours on Tuesday.

sets.title: Radio advertisement

lines.text: Are you tired of long lines at the gym? FitZone is opening its newest location on Elm Street this Saturday. Our new branch features twice as many machines as our other locations and is open twenty-four hours a day. Sign up during opening week and get your first month free. Visit fitzone dot com for details.

sets.ko: 헬스장의 긴 줄에 지치셨나요? 핏존이 이번 토요일 엘름 스트리트에 새 지점을 엽니다. 새 지점은 다른 지점보다 운동 기구가 두 배 많고 24시간 운영합니다. 개장 주간에 가입하시면 첫 달이 무료입니다. 자세한 내용은 핏존 닷컴을 방문하세요.

questions.stem: What is being advertised?
questions.explanation: FitZone is opening its newest location = 새 헬스장 지점.

questions.stem: What is special about the new branch?
questions.explanation: twice as many machines = 기구가 더 많다.

questions.stem: How can listeners get a free month?
choices: By signing up during opening week
questions.explanation: Sign up during opening week and get your first month free.

sets.title: Meeting excerpt

lines.text: Before we finish today's meeting, I want to talk about the customer survey results. Overall, customers are happy with our products, but many said our delivery times are too long. Starting next month, we'll be working with a second shipping company to speed things up. I'd like each team leader to share this news with their staff by Friday.

sets.ko: 오늘 회의를 마치기 전에 고객 설문 결과를 이야기하고 싶어요. 전반적으로 고객들은 제품에 만족하지만 배송 시간이 너무 길다는 의견이 많았어요. 다음 달부터 배송을 빠르게 하려고 두 번째 운송 회사와 함께 일합니다. 팀장들은 금요일까지 이 소식을 팀원들에게 알려 주세요.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?
questions.explanation: talk about the customer survey results.

questions.stem: What did customers complain about?
questions.explanation: delivery times are too long = 배송이 느리다.

questions.stem: What are team leaders asked to do?
questions.explanation: share this news with their staff by Friday.

sets.title: Tour introduction

lines.text: Welcome aboard the Harbor City boat tour. Over the next ninety minutes, we'll pass several of the city's most famous landmarks, including the old lighthouse, which was built in 1872. Please remain seated while the boat is moving, and keep your belongings with you at all times. Refreshments are available at the snack bar on the lower deck. If you'd like a photo with the skyline, our crew will be happy to take one when we stop at the halfway point.

sets.ko: 하버 시티 보트 투어에 탑승하신 것을 환영합니다. 앞으로 90분 동안 1872년에 지어진 옛 등대를 비롯한 도시의 유명 명소를 지나갑니다. 배가 움직이는 동안에는 자리에 앉아 계시고 소지품은 항상 몸에 지니세요. 다과는 아래층 매점에서 이용하실 수 있습니다. 스카이라인을 배경으로 사진을 원하시면 중간 지점에 멈출 때 승무원이 찍어 드립니다.

questions.stem: How long will the tour last?
questions.explanation: Over the next ninety minutes.

questions.stem: Where can listeners buy refreshments?
choices: At the snack bar on the lower deck
questions.explanation: Refreshments are available at the snack bar on the lower deck.

questions.stem: What will the crew do at the halfway point?
questions.explanation: our crew will be happy to take one(사진) when we stop at the halfway point.

sets.title: Phone message (schedule change)

lines.text: Hi, Ms. Brooks, this is Kevin Liu from Summit Consulting. I'm calling about our meeting scheduled for Thursday afternoon. Unfortunately, our lead analyst has been asked to join an urgent project, so we'd like to move the meeting to Friday morning at ten, if that works for you. We'll also send you the updated proposal tonight so you'll have time to look it over beforehand. Please let me know by tomorrow whether the new time is convenient.

sets.ko: 브룩스 씨, 서밋 컨설팅의 케빈 리우입니다. 목요일 오후로 잡힌 회의 건으로 전화드렸어요. 안타깝게도 저희 수석 분석가가 급한 프로젝트에 합류하게 되어, 괜찮으시다면 회의를 금요일 오전 10시로 옮기고 싶습니다. 미리 검토하실 수 있도록 오늘 밤 수정 제안서도 보내 드릴게요. 새 시간이 괜찮은지 내일까지 알려 주세요.

questions.stem: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.explanation: move the meeting to Friday morning = 일정 변경.

questions.stem: Why is the change necessary?
choices: The office is closed on Thursday.
A team member has another urgent task.
questions.explanation: lead analyst has been asked to join an urgent project = 다른 급한 일.

questions.stem: What will the speaker send tonight?
questions.explanation: send you the updated proposal tonight = 수정 제안서(revised proposal).

sets.title: Library announcement

lines.text: Good afternoon, library visitors. The library will be closing in thirty minutes, at six o'clock. If you would like to check out books, please bring them to the front desk now, as the self-checkout machines are being repaired today. Also, our children's reading event this Saturday has been moved from the second floor to the community room, because more families signed up than we expected. Thank you.

sets.ko: 도서관 이용객 여러분, 도서관은 30분 뒤인 6시에 문을 닫습니다. 책을 빌리시려면 지금 안내 데스크로 가져와 주세요. 오늘 무인 대출기는 수리 중입니다. 또한 이번 토요일 어린이 독서 행사는 예상보다 많은 가족이 신청해 2층에서 커뮤니티룸으로 옮겼습니다. 감사합니다.

questions.stem: When will the library close?
questions.explanation: closing in thirty minutes, at six o'clock.

questions.stem: Why should visitors go to the front desk?
choices: Because the machines are not working
To sign up for an event
questions.explanation: the self-checkout machines are being repaired = 기계가 안 된다.

questions.stem: Why was the event moved?
questions.explanation: more families signed up than we expected = 신청자가 예상보다 많다.

sets.title: Workshop introduction

lines.text: Thank you all for coming to today's workshop on writing effective business e-mails. I'm Laura Bennett, and I've worked in corporate communications for over fifteen years. We'll start with a short presentation, and then you'll work in pairs to rewrite some sample e-mails. Before we begin, please make sure you've picked up a handout from the table by the door, since we'll be referring to it throughout the session. We'll take a fifteen-minute break at eleven.

sets.ko: 효과적인 업무 이메일 쓰기 워크숍에 와 주셔서 감사합니다. 저는 로라 베넷이고 15년 넘게 기업 커뮤니케이션 분야에서 일했습니다. 짧은 발표로 시작한 뒤 둘씩 짝을 지어 예시 이메일을 고쳐 써 보겠습니다. 시작하기 전에 문 옆 탁자에서 유인물을 꼭 챙겨 주세요. 수업 내내 보게 될 거예요. 11시에 15분간 쉬겠습니다.

questions.stem: What is the topic of the workshop?
questions.explanation: workshop on writing effective business e-mails.

questions.stem: What will listeners do after the presentation?
questions.explanation: you'll work in pairs = 짝과 함께 한다.

questions.stem: What are listeners asked to do before the workshop begins?
questions.explanation: make sure you've picked up a handout.

sets.title: Choosing a room (graphic)

lines.text: Hi, Tom. I'm booking a room for the training session with the new sales staff next Thursday.
How many people are coming?
Eighteen, including the two trainers.
Then Room 201 is too small. It only holds twelve.
Right. And Room 305 doesn't have a projector, which we'll definitely need for the slides.
What about the one on the fourth floor? It has a projector and enough seats.
Perfect. I'll reserve it now and send everyone the details this afternoon.

sets.ko: 여: 톰, 다음 주 목요일 신입 영업 직원 교육 장소를 예약하려고요. / 남: 몇 명이 와요? / 여: 강사 두 명 포함해서 열여덟 명이요. / 남: 그럼 201호는 작아요. 열두 명까지만 돼요. / 여: 맞아요. 305호는 프로젝터가 없는데 슬라이드 때문에 꼭 필요해요. / 남: 4층 방은요? 프로젝터도 있고 자리도 충분해요. / 여: 좋아요. 지금 예약하고 오후에 모두에게 자세한 내용을 보낼게요.

questions.stem: What event is the woman planning?
questions.explanation: training session for the new sales staff.

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Which room will the woman reserve?
questions.explanation: 4층 방(프로젝터 있고 자리 충분) → 표에서 4층은 410호. 시각 자료 문제는 대화의 단서(4층)와 표를 연결해요.

questions.stem: What will the woman do this afternoon?
questions.explanation: send everyone the details this afternoon.

sets.title: Shipping options (graphic)

lines.text: Hi, I need to send this package to Busan. It's a contract that must arrive by Wednesday.
Today is Monday, so you have a few options. Here's our price list.
Hmm, overnight delivery is a bit expensive. Will the two-day option get there in time?
Yes, it would arrive on Wednesday.
Great, I'll take that. Do I need to fill out a form?
Just write the recipient's phone number here, please.

sets.ko: 남: 이 소포를 부산에 보내야 해요. 수요일까지 꼭 도착해야 하는 계약서예요. / 여: 오늘이 월요일이니 몇 가지 방법이 있어요. 여기 요금표예요. / 남: 익일 배송은 좀 비싸네요. 이틀 배송이면 제때 도착할까요? / 여: 네, 수요일에 도착해요. / 남: 좋아요, 그걸로 할게요. 양식을 작성해야 하나요? / 여: 여기에 받는 분 전화번호만 적어 주세요.

questions.stem: What is the man sending?
questions.explanation: It's a contract that must arrive by Wednesday.

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. How much will the man pay?
questions.explanation: 이틀 배송(Two-Day)을 골랐어요 → 표에서 $15.

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explanation: write the recipient's phone number.

sets.title: Report deadline (intent)

lines.text: Kevin, have you finished the quarterly sales report? The director wants it by noon.
Almost. I'm just waiting for the figures from the Busan branch.
They sent them to me an hour ago. I'll forward them to you now.
Oh, that's a relief. I thought I'd have to call them.
Do you think you can still make the deadline?
It'll be tight, but I'll skip lunch if I have to.
Let me know if you need help checking the numbers.

sets.ko: 여: 케빈, 분기 영업 보고서 끝냈어요? 이사님이 정오까지 원하세요. / 남: 거의요. 부산 지점 수치만 기다리고 있어요. / 여: 한 시간 전에 저한테 보냈어요. 지금 전달할게요. / 남: 다행이네요. 전화해야 하나 했어요. / 여: 그래도 마감 맞출 수 있겠어요? / 남: 빠듯하지만 필요하면 점심 건너뛸게요. / 여: 수치 확인 도움 필요하면 말해요.

questions.stem: What is the man working on?
questions.explanation: quarterly sales report.

questions.stem: Why does the man say, "Oh, that's a relief"?
choices: He no longer needs to contact the branch.
questions.explanation: 수치를 받으려고 전화해야 하나 했는데 여자가 이미 받아 두었다 → 연락할 필요가 없어서 안심. 화자 의도 문제는 앞뒤 맥락으로 판단해요.

questions.stem: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.explanation: Let me know if you need help checking the numbers.

sets.title: New coffee machine (intent, 3 speakers)

lines.text: Have you two tried the new coffee machine in the break room?
I did this morning. It makes great coffee, but it took me ten minutes to figure out the buttons.
Same here. There are no instructions anywhere.
I see. Well, I ordered it, so I guess that's my responsibility.
Maybe you could post a simple guide next to it?
Good idea. The manual is in my desk. I'll make a one-page version this afternoon.
Thanks. That will save everyone a lot of time.

sets.ko: 남1: 휴게실 새 커피 머신 써 봤어요? / 여: 오늘 아침에요. 커피는 맛있는데 버튼 알아내는 데 10분 걸렸어요. / 남2: 저도요. 설명서가 어디에도 없어요. / 남1: 그렇군요. 제가 주문했으니 제 책임이네요. / 여: 옆에 간단한 안내문을 붙이면 어때요? / 남1: 좋은 생각이에요. 설명서가 제 책상에 있어요. 오후에 한 장짜리로 만들게요. / 남2: 고마워요. 다들 시간이 많이 절약되겠어요.

questions.stem: What problem do the speakers mention?
choices: The machine is hard to use.
questions.explanation: 버튼 알아내는 데 10분, 설명서 없음 = 사용하기 어렵다.

questions.stem: What does the man imply when he says, "I ordered it, so I guess that's my responsibility"?
choices: He did not want to buy it.
questions.explanation: 자기가 주문했으니 해결해야 한다는 뜻이에요. 실제로 바로 뒤에 안내문을 만들겠다고 해요.

questions.stem: What will the man do this afternoon?
questions.explanation: I'll make a one-page version this afternoon.

sets.title: Store hours (graphic)

lines.text: Thank you for calling Greenleaf Garden Center. Our spring hours are now in effect. Please note that because of the holiday, we will close early this Friday, at four o'clock. On Saturday, we're holding a free planting workshop at ten A.M. in our greenhouse. Space is limited, so please sign up at the front counter. For directions, press one.

sets.ko: 그린리프 가든 센터에 전화해 주셔서 감사합니다. 봄 영업시간이 적용 중입니다. 공휴일 때문에 이번 금요일은 4시에 일찍 닫습니다. 토요일 오전 10시에는 온실에서 무료 식물 심기 워크숍을 엽니다. 자리가 한정되어 있으니 앞쪽 계산대에서 신청해 주세요. 오시는 길은 1번을 누르세요.

questions.stem: What kind of business is Greenleaf?

sets.title: Team update (intent)

lines.text: Hi everyone. Quick update on the website redesign. The design team finished the new home page yesterday, and the early feedback has been very positive. The launch was planned for next Monday. But we just found out that the online payment page still has some errors. I know what you're thinking. Yes, we've been here before. This time, though, the developers say it's a small fix, so we're moving the launch back by only two days. I'll send an updated schedule this afternoon.
